claims.text: git tag -a <name> creates an annotated tag object with its own message, tagger and date on the current commit (-m gives the message); a tag does not move when new commits are made.
By default git push does not push tags; a tag is pushed when named (git push origin v1.0.0) or with --tags / --follow-tags (or push.followTags).

claims.text: release.yml@stage-2 lines 7-13: on: push: tags: ['v*.*.*']; permissions contents: write (create the GitHub release) and packages: write (push to ghcr.io).
A workflow with on.push.tags filter runs only for tag pushes matching the pattern; pushing the tag stage-2 does not start release.yml (no release run for stage-2 in gh run list).

claims.text: release.yml runs actions/checkout, then ./scripts/release-notes.sh "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" before login/pull/push; the script prints the ## [version] section (no heading) and exits 1 with 'CHANGELOG.md has no section for version X' if missing or empty.
release.yml@stage-2 lines 31-44: commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD), version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}; docker pull both sha-$commit images, docker tag them as $version, docker push; no build step.
